title: Concept: Supabase service role key in a response
description: A Supabase service role label next to a JWT in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The service role key bypasses row-level security, so anyone holding it can read every table in the project, which makes it a full data breach rather than a scoped leak.
applicability: Deployments that render a Supabase service role label next to a JWT into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The service role key bypasses row-level security, so anyone holding it can read every table in the project, which makes it a full data breach rather than a scoped leak.
